fact.text: Fossil gut contents of Arthropleura were a mix of woody plant material, suggesting it was a herbivore.
fact.source_sentence: A. moyseyi was suggested to preserve the original gut contents, a mix of woody plant material, suggesting it was an herbivore.

premise.description: Three hundred million years ago the coal swamps were full of giant arthropods. Eight possible roommates for one night, from a speck to a swamp predator, and the giant that was probably safest to sleep beside.
